description: Find the public code-violation, building-permit and zoning-case datasets UrbanKit has verified for a U.S. city, and how to query them by street. Give a city slug or name (state optional), optionally a kind ('violations', 'permits' or 'zoning') and a street; omit city to list every covered city. Returns each dataset's endpoint (Socrata, ArcGIS, CKAN or CARTO), the address column it searches, its date field and filter, coverage notes, and a ready query URL you run yourself against the city's server. This server does not execute the query and returns no city records: fetch the returned URL yourself. Returns no owner data: for a parcel's owner use get_parcel_endpoint or build_owner_query.

city.description: City slug ('fort-worth') or name ('Fort Worth', 'Fort Worth, TX'). Omit to list covered cities.

state.description: Optional 2-letter code or state name, for a name used in two states.

street.description: Optional street line only, e.g. 'Commerce' or '600 Commerce St'. A street name alone returns the most.

name: get_city_datasets
title: Find a city's violation, permit and zoning datasets
